Running command: cd /workspace/repo-vul/src-vul/capstonenext && python3 - <<'PY'
import zipfile, tempfile, subprocess, os, json
z=zipfile.ZipFile('suite/fuzz/fuzz_disasmnext_seed_corpus.zip')
name='corpus/insn-good.s.cs_e3f000000004'
path='/tmp/poc.bin'
open(path,'wb').write(z.read(name))
trace=[
 {"step":1,"file":"suite/fuzz/fuzz_disasm.c","function":"LLVMFuzzerTestOneInput","line":194,"var":"Data[0]","code":"int i = (int)Data[0] % platforms_len;","note":"The first byte of the attacker-controlled input selects the architecture/mode pair used for disassembly."},
 {"step":2,"file":"suite/fuzz/fuzz_disasm.c","function":"LLVMFuzzerTestOneInput","line":196,"var":"platforms[i]","code":"err = cs_open(platforms[i].arch, platforms[i].mode, &handle);","note":"The chosen platform determines which decoder backend will parse the remaining bytes."},
 {"step":3,"file":"suite/fuzz/fuzz_disasm.c","function":"LLVMFuzzerTestOneInput","line":201,"var":"Data+1, Size-1","code":"size_t count = cs_disasm(handle, Data+1, Size-1, address, 0, &all_insn);","note":"All bytes after the selector are passed as raw instruction stream to Capstone."},
 {"step":4,"file":"arch/MIPS/MIPSDisassembler.c","function":"Mips_disasm","line":None,"var":"instruction decode state","code":"backend-specific decode of the selected MIPS input","note":"The MIPS decoder consumes the crafted bytes and reaches a path where an instruction detail field is left uninitialized."},
 {"step":5,"file":"suite/fuzz/fuzz_disasm.c","function":"LLVMFuzzerTestOneInput","line":208,"var":"detail->regs_read_count / regs_write_count / groups_count","code":"detail = i->detail; ... fprintf(... detail fields ...);","note":"The harness reads and prints instruction detail fields, triggering the use of the uninitialized value in the sink."}
]
open('/workspace/candidate_trace.json','w').write(json.dumps(trace))
res=subprocess.run(['bash','submit.sh',path,'/workspace/candidate_trace.json'],cwd='/workspace',stdout=subprocess.PIPE,stderr=subprocess.STDOUT)
print(res.returncode)
print(res.stdout.decode('latin1','ignore')[:2000])
PY
